_comment: EXT-63 SMOKE, arm 4 — arm 2 plus the RECEIVER CODE-BIAS DATUM.
network.rx_code_bias_datum folds one sum-to-zero gauge per constellation over the
per-station receiver DCB columns — the IGS zero-mean-over-receivers convention, and the
receiver-side counterpart of the W6 per-(constellation,signal) SATELLITE code-bias gauge
that network.external_sat_code_bias gives away along with the satellite biases.
Realized through the SAME family-agnostic SumZeroGauge machinery the ensemble phase-bias
datum already uses (NetworkNormalEquations::foldReducedSumZeroGauges): the receiver DCB
is a LOCAL, Schur-eliminated state, so it cannot be a shared-border row; the hard
w->infinity limit is folded by Woodbury through the cached per-station LDL^T factors as a
rank-1 update on the reduced shared normals.  It APPENDS to the ensemble gauges (which
are empty on this lineage — phase_datum_eq34 is the phase datum here) and rides the same
re-apply lambda, because a within-epoch RAIM re-reduce CLEARS stored gauges.
sbasis_complete stays ARMED as the backstop.  It is NOT expected to carry the load any
more: the persistent 1.33e-4 direction should be gone (that is what this datum gauges),
but the machine-zero ORPHANS remain real — arm 2 saw one at TOW 259410 (G22/L1C, ev
-2.9e-10, span 1.00: a single satellite-signal whose phase bias had no support that
epoch).  Those are Card PA's class and SBC handles them; they are unrelated to the
receiver datum.
WHAT TO READ, in order:
1. 'Network (RXCB-DATUM): N receiver code-bias sum-to-zero gauge(s) folded'.  N should be
~1 per solved epoch (GPS-only, one constellation).  A run-end WARN saying ZERO means
the gauge never found >= 2 stations with a DCB column and this arm is inert.
2. gate_withheld count -> 0, and sbc_engage should drop to the orphans only.
3. a00 in network_vtec_sh_health.csv.  Arms 2/3 walked to -80 / -48 TECU with sigma
collapsing.  If the diagnosis is right this now HOLDS, and holds near the DOY-129
field truth of 30-33 TECU rather than near the 15 TECU prior mean.  a00 sitting on 15
would say the gauge fixed the RANK but the level is still prior-driven.
4. SH health gate: 19/20 emissions withheld in arm 2.  Target is 0.
20 epochs is inside ignition: wiring + datum reachability only, no science claim.
